language_note: All results are risk indicators to investigate, not findings or conclusions.

parameter_definitions.split_window_days: last date - first date <= 30, dates without time of day
parameter_definitions.duplicate_window_days: dates at most 7 apart, dates without time of day
parameter_definitions.clustering_band_width: band below T: 0.9 x T to T
parameter_definitions.comparison_band_width: band above T: T to 1.1 x T
parameter_definitions.candidate_containment_min_chars: both normalised names at least this long for containment
parameter_definitions.award_ratio_flag: annualised estimate / (Awarded Value / contract years) at or above this
parameter_definitions.export_cap_warning_rows: warn of the Contracts Finder export cap at or above this many data rows

window.file_month_definition: most common calendar month of the file's dates

exclusions.narrative: Joint Arrangements (with Other Local Authorities or NHS)
Payments to Other Local Authorities (excl Joint Arrangements)

normalisation_rules.rule: 3: trading name: keep text after last T A / T AS / TRADING AS
4: drop tokens LTD, LIMITED, PLC, LLP
5: drop payment tags (DD PAYMENTS ONLY, CHAPS ONLY, BACS; longest first)
6-fallback: empty result: fall back to the rule-2 result

contracts.active_definition: 'Contract end date' on or after window start (blank = active) and 'Contract start date' on or before window end

thresholds.status: not run: at or below the publication floor of the spend data

thresholds.note: upper bound in ['CPR-54', 'CPR-55'] and lower bound in ['CPR-56'] leave the value itself in neither band (see rules.json notes); the lower-bound flag is used

threshold_clustering.description: Payments in the band just below each threshold, beside the comparison band just above it: a risk indicator to investigate, not a conclusion.

thresholds_not_run.status: not run: at or below the publication floor of the spend data

threshold_clustering.flagged_definition: payments in the band below T, summed over thresholds run

split_purchases.description: Same normalised supplier, two or more payments each under T within the window whose combined total reaches T: an indicator of possible split purchases to investigate. Overlapping windows are merged into one group, so a group's full span can exceed the window; best_window_* gives the highest-total single window inside the group. A group is every payment under T to that supplier dated first_date..last_date; full transaction ids are in the CSV.

thresholds_not_run.status: not run: at or below the publication floor of the spend data

split_purchases.flagged_definition: group totals summed over thresholds run; a payment can sit in groups for more than one threshold

no_published_notice.label: no published notice found
no_published_notice.description: A list of suppliers to request contract evidence for, not a finding. Suppliers whose annualised estimate (3-month total x 4) is at or above the tender/publication threshold and whose normalised name has no exact match among active Contracts Finder notices. The council's contracts register is not an input. Contracts Finder lists only contracts above about £25k, so suppliers below the threshold are never tested and never listed. A candidate is a possible name match for the auditor to confirm; it is never treated as a match.
no_published_notice.companies_house_matching: spend data carries no Companies House numbers; matching is by normalised name only
no_published_notice.flagged_definition: suppliers classed 'no published notice found' against active notices; totals are 3-month £

duplicates.description: Same normalised supplier, same Net amount to the penny, each payment no more than the window apart from the next (connected rows grouped): possible duplicate payments to investigate. Regular fixed-fee payments (e.g. weekly placements) also produce this pattern.
duplicates.flagged_definition: group totals (all rows in each group); repeat_value = total less one payment per group

expired_notice_spend.description: Suppliers paid in the window whose every exact-match notice ended before the window start: an indicator of spend after expiry without an approved extension (App C row D) to investigate; a newer contract may exist with no notice. Candidate-only name matches are listed separately and are never treated as matches.
expired_notice_spend.population: named suppliers (Redacted left out), any amount

spend_vs_award.description: Suppliers with exactly one exact-match active single-supplier notice with Awarded Value > 0: ratio = annualised estimate / (Awarded Value / contract years). A ratio at or above the flag is an indicator of spend beyond the award without an approved variation (App C row E) to investigate; award values may be estimates or maxima.
spend_vs_award.flagged_definition: suppliers with ratio at or above award_ratio_flag; 3-month £

high_value_suppliers.description: Every normalised supplier whose annualised estimate is at or above the quote threshold, sorted by £: the population to request contract evidence for.

redacted_not_attributable.note: Redacted £ cannot be attributed to a supplier
